items.title: Landslagsprofil reagerer på tribuneskandalen: – Fetteren min sto en meter unna
items.excerpt: En i familien til Bodø/Glimt-stjernen Patrick Berg opplevde tribunekollapsen i Tromsø på nært hold.

items.title: Czechia braces for massive protest against cuts to public media
items.excerpt: A fast-tracked bill to cut public media funding has sparked strikes, rallies and fears for the independence of public broadcasting in Czechia. A massive protest is planned for Prague on Sunday.

items.title: After suffering its worst election result, what's next for the ANC — and for South Africa?
items.excerpt: A crushing local election result across the country has left South Africa's ruling ANC searching for answers. Experts say the vote reflects public frustration with service delivery failures — signaling a political shift.
